$comment: PCBviber EasyEDA Pro extension manifest. Loaded via EasyEDA Pro → Advanced → Extensions → Import. The extension opens a long-poll connection to the PCBviber server's /api/eda-relay/* routes and dispatches commands the server pushes (Sprint 10+ tools).
name: pcbviber
description: Lets Claude / Cursor / any MCP-aware AI assistant control your EasyEDA Pro workspace via the PCBviber server. Component lookup, project introspection, DRC, manufacturing exports.
$comment_engines: Pin against an EasyEDA Pro Extension API minor — caret-range so we accept patch upgrades but pause on a minor that might rename methods.
$comment_entry: Plain JS — no build step. EasyEDA loads src/index.js directly. If we ever grow this enough to need TypeScript, add a build that emits to dist/index.js and bump this path.
$comment_activation: Activated on workspace open so the long-poll bridge connects as early as possible — the AI client expects a tool call to resolve in seconds, not after a manual 'enable extension' click.
$comment_permissions: ExternalInteractions is required to reach the PCBviber server via SYS_ClientUrl.request. The user must enable it once at install time; without it, the long-poll throws every call and the panel shows 'permission required'.
$comment_panels: Single status panel docked at the bottom of the editor. Shows connection state + last-checked timestamp so the user can confirm the bridge is alive without opening DevTools.
